summary: Four commits on this branch refine cleanup-next-build-lock.js to fix false-positive stuck-process detection and orphaned next build processes blocking the quality gate. A subsequent branch dev/844c84ec-fix-quality-gate-build-failing-in-leadfl addressed the same root cause with a broader fix (orphan detection + timeout kills + 8 unit tests) and was merged as PR #1537 on 2026-05-16. This branch has no open PR, no matching task row, and main is 191 commits ahead of the merge base. Safe to delete.

commits.subject: fix: prevent false-positive stuck-process detection in cleanup-next-build-lock
fix: use lsof + orphan-check for build lock cleanup (replaces ps+awk)
fix: detect and kill orphaned next build processes in lock cleanup
fix: pgrep "next build" not "next" to avoid false-positive from dev servers

supersededBy.title: Fix: kill stuck builds after timeout to prevent lock interference

riskDetails: All functional improvements on this branch are fully covered by the superseding PR #1537 which is already in main. Deleting this branch loses no work.
